proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image Generation API Fallback Chain & Silent Crashes
proposals.current_pain_description: Currently, HF is down, AI Horde is blocked by GitHub Actions IPs, and Gemini returns 429. If Pollinations or Together AI fails, the pipeline crashes mid-way, wasting workflow minutes and stopping Hugo's daily production completely.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a robust pythonic API wrapper class (`FallbackImageGenerator`) with automated retries, exponential backoff, and a strict fallback hierarchy: 1. Runware (PAYG, high-quality FLUX), 2. Together AI (Free FLUX-schnell), 3. Cloudflare Workers AI (Free SDXL), 4. Pollinations (No-key fallback). Integrate this single client into all image pipelines.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 95% of workflow failures due to API downtime, ensuring Hugo always gets a generated image.

proposals.issue_title: Missing Quality Gate for AI-Generated Coloring Pages
proposals.current_pain_description: Pollinations and raw models occasionally output images with grey shading, broken anatomy, double borders, or solid black fills, which are unsellable as coloring pages. Hugo has to manually inspect every image on his phone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-generation validation step (`agent_gemini_quality_check`) using the free Gemini 2.5 Flash vision API. Gemini analyzes the generated image against strict criteria (no grayscale shading, closed clean black outlines, white background). If it fails, automatic regeneration is triggered with an adjusted prompt up to 3 times.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves hours of manual inspection time and prevents publishing low-quality, review-destroying books on Amazon KDP.

proposals.issue_title: Git Bloat and Termux Storage Limits on Android
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo works exclusively on an Android phone using Termux. Storing large generated PNG/PDF assets directly inside the GitHub repository will quickly inflate repository size, making `git pull` slow, resource-heavy, and prone to crashing Termux.
proposals.proposed_fix: Modify the pipeline to avoid committing raw high-resolution output assets to the main branch. Instead, have GitHub Actions upload finalized PDFs/PNGs directly to a free-tier Cloudflare R2 bucket (10GB free/month) or as GitHub Release Assets, committing only the lightweight metadata JSON/CSV files to the repository.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents Termux from running out of disk space/RAM and keeps git sync speeds fast on mobile connections.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Upload Bottleneck for KDP & Redbubble
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo has 10 hours a week. Generating 100 assets takes minutes on GHA, but uploading them manually via a mobile browser to KDP and Redbubble creates a massive bottleneck that stops him from reaching a 'live' state.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create an automated 'Metadata Packager' at the end of every pipeline. This script must generate standard CSV templates pre-formatted for popular bulk upload tools (like Redbubble automation extensions or KDP bulk uploaders), along with organized ZIP files hosted on a direct download link, minimizing Hugo's manual input to simple copy-pastes.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces publishing time per product from 15 minutes to under 2 minutes, enabling high-volume listing.

proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality vector drawings generated for coloring books are stored as flat rasters. They are not being cross-pollinated into other highly profitable, low-competition formats like SVGs for Etsy or transparent PNGs for Redbubble stickers.
proposals.proposed_fix: Introduce an automatic post-processing step using `potrace` (installed via GHA apt-get) to convert black-and-white coloring book pages into clean SVGs. Save these SVGs to the `produce_svg_pack` output folder automatically, instantly doubling the product output from a single generation run.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Turns 1 coloring book asset into 2 products (KDP interior page + Etsy SVG cut file) with zero extra API costs.

proposals.issue_title: Silent GHA Pipeline Failures on Mobile
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo is not constantly checking GitHub Actions on his phone. When a generation run fails due to quota limits, API timeouts, or syntax errors, the failure remains silent until Hugo manually checks GHA logs.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a lightweight notification step to the GitHub Actions YAML files. Use a curl request to a free Telegram Bot API or Discord Webhook, sending a direct message to Hugo's phone whenever a workflow fails, including the specific pipeline name and the error summary.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Immediate feedback on mobile, reducing pipeline downtime and allowing quick debugging from Termux.
